name: Primeval Awareness
description: Use your action and spend a ranger spell slot. You sense whether undead, fiends, fey, elementals, dragons, celestials or aberrations are present within 1 mile (6 miles in your favored terrain). The sense lasts 1 minute per level of the slot.
You learn only whether they are there, not their location or number.

name: Hide in Plain Sight
description: Spend 1 minute making camouflage from mud, dirt, plants, soot and similar materials you have on hand.

Then press against a solid surface (tree, wall) at least as large as you. While you stay there without moving, taking actions or reactions, you get +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Moving or acting breaks it, and you must camouflage again.

name: Vanish
description: Hide as a bonus action.
Only magic can track you, unless you choose to leave a trail.

name: Foe Slayer
description: Once per turn, when you attack one of your favored enemies, add your Wisdom modifier to either the attack roll or the damage roll.
You can decide after seeing the roll, as long as the roll's effects are not yet applied.

name: Colossus Slayer
trigger: You hit a wounded creature with a weapon attack
description: Once per turn, a weapon hit on a creature that is below its maximum hit points adds 1d8 damage.

name: Giant Killer
trigger: A creature of Large size or bigger, no more than 5 ft away, attacks you
description: When a Large or bigger creature within 5 ft attacks you, hit or miss, you may answer with an attack against it right after, if you can see it.

name: Horde Breaker
trigger: You make a weapon attack (once per turn)
description: Each of your turns, one weapon attack can earn a bonus swing: attack again with that weapon, aimed at a different creature standing within 5 ft of the first target and inside the weapon's range.

name: Escape the Horde
description: Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

name: Multiattack Defense
description: After a creature hits you, you gain +4 AC against its later attacks for the rest of that turn.

name: Steel Will
description: You have advantage on saves against being frightened.

name: Volley
description: Choose a spot in view that lies inside your weapon's range. Shoot every creature within 10 ft of that spot, rolling a separate attack for each target and spending ammunition on each as usual.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: Make a melee attack against every creature within 5 ft of you, each with its own attack roll.

name: Evasion
description: On a Dexterity save that halves damage, you take none if you pass and half if you fail.

name: Stand Against the Tide
trigger: A hostile creature's melee attack misses you
description: Turn the miss around. Spend your reaction to pick another creature (not the attacker); the attacker makes that same attack again, now against your pick.

name: Uncanny Dodge
trigger: An attacker you can see hits you
description: When an attacker you can see hits you, halve that attack's damage to you.

name: Ranger's Companion
uses: Replace a dead companion in 8 hours
description: You gain a beast companion: a beast of Medium size or smaller with challenge rating 1/4 or lower (hawk, mastiff and panther are in appendix D). Add your proficiency bonus to its AC, attack and damage rolls, and proficient saves and skills.
Its hit point maximum is its normal one or 4 x your ranger level, whichever is higher. It acts on your initiative but only moves unless you command it (see Companion Commands).
With only the beast along, you move stealthily at normal pace in favored terrain. From level 15, a spell you cast on yourself can also affect the beast within 30 ft.
If it dies, bond with another willing beast over 8 hours.

name: Companion Commands
description: On your turn you can direct where the beast moves for free. Spend your action to have it Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help. Once you have Extra Attack, you may make one weapon attack yourself when you order its Attack.
From level 11 the companion makes two attacks when ordered to Attack.

name: Exceptional Training
description: On a turn your beast doesn't attack, use a bonus action to have it Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help on its turn.

name: Aberrations
description: Aberrations count as your favored enemy. Track them with advantage on Wisdom (Survival), and recall lore about them with advantage on Intelligence checks. You also pick up one language they speak, if they have one.
You pick another favored enemy at 6th and 14th level.

name: Beasts
description: Beasts count as your favored enemy. Track them with advantage on Wisdom (Survival), and recall lore about them with advantage on Intelligence checks. You also pick up one language they speak, if they have one.
You pick another favored enemy at 6th and 14th level.

description: Undead count as your favored enemy. Track them with advantage on Wisdom (Survival), and recall lore about them with advantage on Intelligence checks. You also pick up one language they speak, if they have one.

name: Two Humanoid Races
description: Instead of a creature type, you may name two humanoid races, such as gnolls and orcs. Both count as favored enemies, with the same tracking and lore advantages and one language they speak.
You pick another favored enemy at 6th and 14th level.

name: Arctic
description: Arctic is a favored terrain. Your proficiency bonus is doubled on Intelligence or Wisdom checks about it when you use a skill you are proficient in.

Traveling there for an hour or more: difficult terrain does not slow your group, only magic can get it lost, you stay alert while busy, you can sneak at a normal pace when alone, you find twice the food when foraging, and tracking reveals exact numbers, sizes and age.
You pick more favored terrain at 6th and 10th level.

description: Coast is a favored terrain. Your proficiency bonus is doubled on Intelligence or Wisdom checks about it when you use a skill you are proficient in.

name: Dread Ambusher
description: Add your Wisdom modifier to your initiative rolls.

In each combat, during your very first turn, you get +10 ft of walking speed until the turn ends. Take the Attack action that turn and it includes one extra weapon attack; if that attack hits, add 1d8 damage of the weapon's type.

name: Stalker's Flurry
trigger: A weapon attack of yours misses
description: Once on each of your turns, when a weapon attack misses, you get a follow-up weapon attack within that same action.

name: Shadowy Dodge
trigger: An attacker without advantage rolls to hit you
description: Use your reaction to give that attack roll disadvantage. Decide before you know whether it hits.

name: Gathered Swarm
trigger: You hit a creature with an attack
description: A swarm of intangible nature spirits shares your space until you die. Once on each of your turns, immediately when one of your attacks hits a creature, the swarm can help in one way:
• The target takes 1d6 piercing damage.
• The target makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or the swarm shoves it as far as 15 ft horizontally, any direction you pick.
• The swarm carries you 5 ft horizontally, in a direction you choose.
Level 11 (Mighty Swarm): the damage becomes 1d8, a creature that fails the Strength save can also be knocked prone, and being carried by the swarm gives you half cover until your next turn starts.

name: Writhing Tide
description: Bonus action: part of your swarm lifts you. For 1 minute you have a 10-ft flying speed and can hover; it ends early if you are incapacitated.

name: Swarming Dispersal
description: Use your reaction to resist that damage. You dissolve into your swarm and teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 ft, where you and the swarm reappear.

name: Detect Portal
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: You sense the distance and direction to the nearest planar portal no more than 1 mile from you. The Dungeon Master's Guide (chapter 2, planar travel) has example portals.

name: Planar Warrior
description: Choose a creature you can see within 30 ft. Your next weapon hit on it this turn turns all of that attack's damage into force damage and adds 1d8 force damage (2d8 from ranger level 11).

name: Ethereal Step
uses: Once per short or long rest

spells.uses: Bonus action, no spell slot; ends with your turn; once per short or long rest

description: Cast etherealness as a bonus action without spending a spell slot. The spell lasts only until this turn is over.

name: Distant Strike
description: Before each of its attacks, teleport up to 10 ft into an unoccupied space in sight.
Once you have attacked 2 or more different creatures with the action, you get 1 more attack in it, aimed at a third creature.

name: Spectral Defense
trigger: An attack deals damage to you
description: Slip between the planes: you resist all the damage from that attack this turn.

name: Hunter's Sense
description: Pick a creature you can see within 60 ft. You instantly know its damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities, if it has any. A target shielded from divination magic reads as having none.

name: Slayer's Prey
description: Choose a visible creature no more than 60 ft away as your prey. Your first weapon hit on it in each turn adds 1d6 damage from the weapon.
It stays your prey until your next short or long rest, or until you pick a new target.

name: Supernatural Defense
trigger: Your Slayer's Prey target forces you to save, or you check to escape its grapple
description: Add 1d6 to that saving throw or ability check.

name: Magic-User's Nemesis
trigger: You see a creature within 60 ft cast a spell or teleport
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Try to foil it: the creature makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On a failure the spell or teleport is wasted with no effect.

name: Slayer's Counter
trigger: Your Slayer's Prey target forces you to make a saving throw
description: Make one weapon attack against it right before you roll the save. If it hits, you pass the save automatically, on top of the attack's normal effects.

name: Favored Foe
trigger: Your attack roll hits a creature
uses: Proficiency bonus times per long rest
description: When an attack roll of yours hits a creature, you can mark it as a favored enemy; the mark lasts 1 minute. Holding the mark takes concentration, like a spell.
Once on each of your turns, when you damage the marked creature (the hit that marks it included), add 1d4 to that damage: 1d6 from ranger level 6, 1d8 from level 14.
Marks per long rest: your proficiency bonus. A marked creature counts as a favored enemy for Foe Slayer.

name: Deft Explorer
description: Canny (level 1): pick one skill you are proficient in; your proficiency bonus is doubled on checks with it. You also learn 2 extra languages to speak, read and write.
Roving (level 6): your walking speed rises by 5 ft, and you get climbing and swimming speeds equal to it.
Tireless (level 10): temporary hit points as an action, and short rests ease exhaustion (its own card).

name: Additional Ranger Spells
description: Adds Tasha's extra spells to the Ranger list, so you can learn them as ranger spells.
They carry an Optional tag wherever they show.

name: Primal Awareness
uses: Each spell once per long rest without a slot

spells.uses: Once per long rest without a spell slot
Once per long rest without a spell slot
Once per long rest without a spell slot
Once per long rest without a spell slot
Once per long rest without a spell slot

description: You learn speak with animals at ranger level 3, beast sense at 5, speak with plants at 9, locate creature at 13 and commune with nature at 17, each only if you don't know it already. They don't count against your ranger spells known.
Each of them can be cast once without spending a spell slot; that free cast comes back when you finish a long rest.

name: Nature's Veil
uses: Proficiency bonus times per long rest
description: Turn invisible, along with what you wear and carry, until your next turn starts.
Uses equal your proficiency bonus; all of them return on a long rest.

name: Primal Companion
description: You summon a primal beast that is friendly to you and your allies and follows your orders. Pick its stat block (Land, Sea or Sky beast; it uses your proficiency bonus) and what animal it looks like.

It acts on your turn. It moves and reacts on its own but only takes the Dodge action, unless you spend a bonus action to give it another action. Using the Attack action, you can trade one of your own attacks for an order that makes it Attack. While you are incapacitated it acts as it likes.
If it died less than 1 hour ago, touch it as an action and spend a spell slot of level 1 or higher: it comes back after 1 minute at full hit points.
Finishing a long rest lets you swap in a new beast, which appears within 5 ft of you; the old one vanishes. It also vanishes if you die.
Bestial Fury still applies (Player's Handbook p. 93): from ranger level 11, the beast makes two attacks whenever it takes the Attack action.
Share Spells still applies (Player's Handbook p. 93): from ranger level 15, a spell you cast on yourself can also affect the beast if it is within 30 ft of you.
Stat block: Tasha's p. 61.

name: Tireless
uses: Proficiency bonus times per long rest
description: Give yourself 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier temporary hit points (at least 1).
Uses equal your proficiency bonus; all of them return on a long rest. Each short rest you finish also lowers your exhaustion level by 1, if you have any.

name: Dreadful Strikes
description: Add 1d4 psychic damage. A given creature takes this bonus no more than once per turn.
Level 11: the extra damage becomes 1d6.

name: Beguiling Twist
trigger: A save against being charmed or frightened succeeds for you or for a creature in sight within 120 ft
description: Choose another creature in sight, no more than 120 ft away: it makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On a failure you make it charmed or frightened (your pick) for 1 minute. It saves again as each of its turns ends; one success frees it.
Always on: advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

name: Fey Reinforcements
uses: Once per long rest without a spell slot

spells.uses: Once per long rest without a spell slot

description: Cast summon fey with no material component; once per long rest you can cast it without a spell slot. You always know it, and it doesn't count against your ranger spells known.
When you begin casting it, you may drop the need for concentration; that casting then lasts 1 minute.

name: Misty Wanderer

spells.uses: Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest, no slot

description: Cast misty step without a spell slot.
Each time you cast misty step, you can take a willing creature within 5 ft that you can see along. It lands in an empty space you pick, no more than 5 ft from where you arrive.
